# Code of conduct

Audiout is a small project. The rules are short because they can be.

## The standard

Be decent to people. Assume the person on the other end is doing their best with
less context than you have. Criticise the code, the design or the decision —
never the person who made it.

Not welcome here: harassment of any kind, personal or political attacks,
insulting or derogatory comments, publishing anyone's private information, or
sustained disruption of a discussion.

This applies in issues, pull requests, discussions, commit messages, and
anywhere you're representing the project.

## Enforcement

Report anything that crosses the line to **support@audiout.app**. Reports stay
private.

The maintainer will edit, hide or delete comments that break these rules and
will explain why. Repeated or serious breaches lose you access to the project's
spaces, without further warning.

Adapted, loosely and much shortened, from the
[Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org).
